title: Showroom · City Centre 2, Science City
address: City Centre 2, Science City Rd, near Hir Party Plot, Panchamrut Bunglows II, Sola, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 380060
description: Ground floor showroom in City Centre 2 on Science City Road, Sola, offering 3,402 sq.ft super built up and 1,940 sq.ft carpet with a 20 ft frontage.

Part of a G+14 building with one lift and three showrooms on the ground floor. Rent is quoted at ₹100 per sq.ft on super built up or ₹175 per sq.ft on carpet. Suited to furniture, fashion, jewellery, a bank, cafe or restaurant.
